cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys
PROG="/app/submission/scheduler.py"
rng=random.Random(4242)
bad=0
for it in range(60):
    Q=rng.randint(1,4); L=rng.randint(1,3)
    U=rng.choice([4, 16, 100, 4096])
    R=rng.randint(1,min(12,U))
    cuts=sorted(rng.sample(range(1,U),R-1)) if R>1 else []
    borders=[0]+cuts+[U]
    nsteps=rng.randint(5,60)
    steps=[]; c=0; t=0
    for i in range(nsteps):
        t+=rng.randint(1,3)
        arr=[]
        for lane in rng.sample(range(L), rng.randint(0,L)):
            c+=1
            arr.append({"id":"z%d"%c,"lane":lane,"rank":rng.randrange(U)})
        steps.append({"t":t,"serve":rng.random()<0.8,"arrivals":arr})
    obj={"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
         "capacity":rng.randint(1,8),"epoch":rng.choice([1,2,3,5]),"steps":steps}
    proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',PROG],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    if proc.returncode!=0:
        print("FAIL rc", proc.returncode); bad+=1; continue
    out=json.loads(proc.stdout)
    R0=len(borders)-1
    # invariants
    for ev in out["events"]:
        if ev["update"] is not None:
            b=ev["update"]["borders"]; w=ev["update"]["weights"]
            assert len(b)==R0+1, (b,R0)
            assert len(w)==R0
            assert b[0]==0 and b[-1]==U
            assert all(b[i]<b[i+1] for i in range(len(b)-1)), b
    fin=out["final"]
    assert len(fin["borders"])==R0+1 and len(fin["weights"])==R0 and len(fin["histogram"])==R0
    assert len(fin["rr"])==R0 and all(len(r)==L for r in fin["rr"])
    assert len(fin["queues"])==Q
    tot=fin["totals"]
    assert tot["accepted"]==tot["departed"]+sum(len(q) for q in fin["queues"]), tot
    assert tot["attempted"]==tot["accepted"]+tot["dropped"]
    # conservation of ranks in queues
print("controller invariant test done, failures:", bad)
EOF
